product.description: Monoprice™12‑in‑1 USB‑C® Triple Display Wedge‑Style Docking Station with DP 1.4 Alt Mode SupportBoost Your Productivity with the Monoprice 12‑in‑1 USB‑C Dock: Triple‑Display Support, Ultra‑Fast Data, 100W PD Charging, Gigabit Ethernet, SD/microSD Slots, and a Sleek Wedge Design That Doubles as a Laptop StandIntroducing the Monoprice 12‑in‑1 USB‑C Triple‑Display Docking Station‑your all‑in‑one connectivity solution designed to elevate productivity and streamline any modern workspace. With its sleek wedge form factor, this innovative dock not only saves space but also doubles as a stable laptop stand, making it ideal for both desktop and mobile setups. Compatible with virtually all USB‑C and Thunderbolt™ laptops, PCs, and select mobile devices, it transforms a single USB‑C port into a versatile powerhouse of connectivity.Experience true multitasking with support for triple‑display output through a combination of two HDMI® ports and one DisplayPort®, supporting resolutions up to 8K on DisplayPort and up to 4K on each HDMI port. Integrated DP 1.4 Alt Mode and MST/SST capabilities enable multiple independent displays on Windows® or mirrored screens on macOS®, ensuring seamless presentations, immersive multitasking, and smooth, high‑quality video performance.This docking station offers an impressive array of ports, including three high‑speed USB‑A data ports, one USB‑C Gen 2 port, an RJ45 Gigabit Ethernet port for reliable network access, simultaneous SD™ and microSD™ card slots for convenient file transfers, and a 3.5mm audio jack for clear sound output. The USB‑C Power Delivery charging port supplies up to 100W to keep your device powered throughout demanding workdays, while advanced features such as Fast Role Swap and a built‑in security lock slot provide added convenience and peace of mind.Whether in the office, at home, or on the go, the Monoprice 12‑in‑1 Docking Station simplifies digital workflows, maximizes efficiency, and delivers a clean, organized workspace tailored for today's dynamic professionals.Triple‑display output capability via two HDMI ports and one DisplayPort, supporting up to 8K on DisplayPort and 4K on each HDMISupports DisplayPort 1.4 Alt Mode and MST/SST for independent or mirrored displays on Windows and macOSHigh‑speed data transfer with two USB‑A Gen 2 ports and one USB‑C Gen 2 port, each capable of 10Gbps rates, plus an additional USB‑A Gen 1 port supporting up to 5GbpsGigabit Ethernet port provides reliable wired networking and supports Wake‑on‑LAN for remote device activationSD and microSD card slots allow simultaneous operation and fast file transfers up to 104MB/s3.5mm audio jack supports digital audio with high sampling rates up to 192kHz / 24‑bit for premium sound qualityUSB‑C Power Delivery charging port delivers up to 100W, ensuring your device stays poweredFast Role Swap feature prevents disconnection of devices when unplugging the PD adapterSpace‑saving wedge design doubles as a stable laptop stand, ideal for modern workstations and mobile setupsIncludes standard security lock slot for enhanced device security TRIPLE DISPLAY SUPPORTConnect up to three external monitors simultaneously using two HDMI ports and one DisplayPort, with resolutions reaching 8K on DisplayPort and 4K on each HDMI.
